_meta.note: Owner credential elicitation for a PTY job blocked on a password prompt (status shows awaiting_credential). The OWNER is asked through a channel the model cannot read: first, when the MCP client declared URL-mode elicitation, a one-time loopback page the client links the owner to; else a prompt the daemon opens (Windows CredUI; SSH_ASKPASS / ssh-askpass / zenity / kdialog / pinentry on a unix desktop). The daemon types the answer into the job itself. Without a native prompt the response names the admin CLI command the owner runs. The model only ever receives a status; pty_command_write_stdin stays SecretInputDenied (TC44). There is no MCP tool for credential_provide.

unknown_job_error_example.message: daemon ipc error [UnknownJob]: pty job 'job_018f0000000000000000000000000003' is not live

invariants: the response carries job_id, status, and (only with owner_action_required) the owner's CLI command; never the password, its length, or prompt text
one owner prompt per password prompt: a repeat call replays the outcome or keeps waiting on the open prompt, never asks twice
timeout means the owner has not answered within 60 s; the prompt stays open
the daemon types the owner's answer itself and audits credential_provided with job, kind, and source only
the owner page URL (a single-use token) goes to the MCP client in elicitation/create, never into a tool result
